title: Ta Oto Farm
script:
-- TAF Admin Script
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Admin komutları
local AdminCommands = {
    ["kill"] = function(target)
        if target.Character then
            target.Character:BreakJoints()
        end
    end,
    
    ["kick"] = function(target)
        target:Kick("Admin tarafından atıldınız")
    end,
    
    ["bring"] = function(target)
        if target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        end
    end,
    
    ["to"] = function(target)
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        end
    end,
    
    ["invisible"] = function(target)
        if target.Character then
            for _, part in pairs(target.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.Transparency = 1
                end
            end
        end
    end,
    
    ["visible"] = function(target)
        if target.Character then
            for _, part in pairs(target.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.Transparency = 0
                end
            end
        end
    end
}

-- Komut işleme
function processCommand(msg)
    if msg:sub(1, 1) == ";" then
        local args = {}
        for word in msg:gmatch("%w+") do
            table.insert(args, word:lower())
        end
        
        local command = args[2]
        local targetName = args[3]
        
        if command and AdminCommands[command] then
            local target = nil
            if targetName then
                for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p.Name:lower():find(targetName:lower()) then
                        target = p
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
                target = player
            end
            
            if target then
                AdminCommands[command](target)
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Chat dinleyici
player.Chatted:Connect(processCommand)

-- GUI oluşturma
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 200)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
TextLabel.Text = "TAF Admin Panel"
TextLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TextLabel.Parent = Frame

local ScrollingFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
ScrollingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -30)
ScrollingFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 300)
ScrollingFrame.Parent = Frame

local commands = {
    ";kill [isim] - Oyuncuyu öldürür",
    ";kick [isim] - Oyuncuyu atar",
    ";bring [isim] - Oyuncuyu yanına getirir",
    ";to [isim] - Oyuncunun yanına gidersin",
    ";invisible [isim] - Görünmez yapar",
    ";visible [isim] - Görünür yapar"
}

for i, cmd in pairs(commands) do
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 25)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, (i-1)*30)
    label.Text = cmd
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = ScrollingFrame
end

print("TAF Admin Script yüklendi! Komutlar:")
for _, cmd in pairs(commands) do
    print(cmd)
end
